text.1:5: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.
text.2:45: Seek help in patience and prayer; and truly it is hard save for the humble-minded,
text.2:153: O ye who believe! Seek help in steadfastness and prayer. Lo! Allah is with the steadfast.
text.7:128: And Moses said unto his people: Seek help in Allah and endure. Lo! the earth is Allah's. He giveth it for an inheritance to whom He will. And lo! the sequel is for those who keep their duty (unto Him).
